test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"jewellery."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank is asking for a noun that can be stored or kept.
 
• **"Jewellery"** is the most appropriate option as it is a common item that is often stored.
 
• **"Jewellery" **means objects such as rings, etc. that are worn as personal decoration. (अँगूठियाँ आदि आभूषण)
 
 
• **Example**: *She has a piece of **jewellery**__*.
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• **Correct passage**:

........He has put some __**jewellery**__ in my coat. Take it, and when he comes back, give it to him........​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (papers)** could also be stored, but it is not as common as jewellery. (a material made in thin sheets that you use for writing or drawing on, covering things, etc. काग़ज़)
 
• **Option 3 (coins) **is a good choice, but it is more specific than the other options and may not always be relevant. (a piece of money made of metal. सिक्‍का)
 
• **Option 4 (things)** is too vague and could refer to almost anything. (an object that is not named. चीज़, वस्‍तु)

4a:Tbec,

The correct answer is "coat.&am
